correctness.rationale: The complete nonconstant Johnson-scheme spectral table follows from the explicit binomial inversion formula in RESULT.md. Both C^2 lower bounds follow from nonnegative combinations of eigenvalue inequalities with the noncontracting pair bounds. Explicit orbit squared-distance patterns satisfy all three eigenvalue inequalities, so Schoenberg centering produces Euclidean embeddings for every n≥8. Rigidity follows from equality in orbit averages and bounding each pair; exact arithmetic reproduces all critical identities for n=8..60 and complete Gram PSD for n=8,9,10.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The diameter-two KG(n,3) is not strongly regular: for nonadjacent triples meeting in one versus two elements, common-neighbor counts are C(n-5,3) versus C(n-4,3). Thus previous distance-regular exact constants, including the strongly regular KG(n,2) case, do not imply the present n≥8 KG(n,3) formula. Robertson’s general SDP expresses an optimization problem but does not evaluate these parameters.
